_about: Per-card precedent/likeness values for go_generator PRECEDENT_RULE / LIKENESS_RULE, read by historical.py. Only keys listed in 'active' reach a prompt (2026-10-18: the six-render test T1-T6; the A5 roll-out adds the rest after the owner passes the test). Face features checked 2026-10-18 against the Wikipedia/Commons portraits (Adamkus official portrait: no spectacles, broad smiling face; Darius broad square face; Girenas narrower oval face; Binkis wears a tie) and corrected from the planner's draft; precedent texts name no place. 2026-10-19 (A5 roll-out, owner verdicts): 0906_autorius removed from active (owner: keep the original card); 113, 122, 2263_inzinierius (owner: 'All three') and 138 (owner: 'Yes, the 1939 basketball team') added. Their face words come from the planner's likeness_cards.csv; the executor could not view the portraits this round, so they stay UNVERIFIED (Basanavičius's beard and bald forehead, Čiurlionis's moustache are the familiar portrait features). 2026-10-19 (round 4, owner 'go back to the original'): 0964_prezidentas removed from active; the shipped picture (no likeness, no Vytis) is back and its entry stays here for the record.
